verdict.rationale: Data-use and AI-training controls are a fair privacy question for a terminal app, since some terminals ship AI features with training opt-outs. However, the evidence pack contains no documented AI-training opt-out, data-use policy, or statement about model training. The app being local and open source is adjacent context, not a documented control for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
